ce7d3182b30f173b.description: Install, inspect, maintain, calibrate, and troubleshoot instrumentation and control systems within Oil & Gas and petrochemical facilities. Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on field instrumentation devices, transmitters, meters, and control equipment. Troubleshoot and maintain Distributed Control Systems (DCS), Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC), and Remote Terminal Units (RTU). Read and interpret Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&ID) and Instrument Loop Diagrams (ILD). Perform instrument loop checking, calibration, and functional testing to ensure accurate process measurement and control. Inspect and maintain pressure, temperature, level, and flow measurement instruments. Install, configure, and troubleshoot radar transmitters and other field instrumentation devices. Support the operation and maintenance of complex control and analyzer systems. Perform troubleshooting and maintenance of control systems from Honeywell, Invensys, Yokogawa, Emerson, and GE. Monitor and troubleshoot cascade, ratio, feedback, and feedforward control loops. Configure and maintain instrumentation communication protocols, including HART and Fieldbus. Perform vibration monitoring and assist in identifying equipment performance issues. Coordinate with engineering, operations, and maintenance teams to resolve instrumentation and control system issues. Ensure compliance with applicable safety procedures, technical standards, and operational requirements. Prepare maintenance reports, calibration records, and technical documentation. - Education: Candidates with a Degree: Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation and Control Engineering, Control and Instrumentation Systems Engineering, Automation Control, or a Bachelor's degree in a Technical, Trade, or Vocational field specializing in Instrumentation and Control Engineering. Expat Candidates Without a Degree: High School Certificate or Vocational School Diploma in Instrumentation and Control Engineering. - Experience: Candidates with a Degree: Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in the Oil & Gas sector. Candidates Without a Degree: Minimum 11 years of relevant experience in the Oil & Gas sector. - English Language Proficiency: Minimum IELTS score of 6.0 or equivalent TOEFL scores: Internet-Based (iBT): 60 Paper-Based (PBT): 498 Computer-Based (CBT): 171 - Preferred Technical Skills & Experience: Experience in Oil & Gas and petrochemical environments. Strong knowledge of instrumentation field devices, transmitters, and industrial control systems. Ability to read and interpret P&ID and Instrument Loop Diagrams (ILD). Experience with DCS, PLC, and RTU systems. Familiarity with Honeywell, Invensys, Yokogawa, Emerson, GE, and Fox I/A control systems. Knowledge of pressure, level, and flow measurement instruments and meters. Experience with instrument installation, calibration, and troubleshooting. Understanding of cascade, ratio, feedback, and feedforward control strategies. Knowledge of Fieldbus and HART communication protocols. Experience with radar transmitters and complex analyzer systems. Familiarity with vibration analysis and equipment monitoring. Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

ced90a16a191d6a8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المياه الخليجية للمقاولات عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال وصيانة المعدات. نظرة عامة على المسؤوليات يتولى المهندس الكهربائي مسؤولية شاملة تشمل إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة جميع مراحل التنفيذ. كما يشمل الدور إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات الكهربائية، وتشخيص الأعطال، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والمعالجة، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير الفنية المتخصصة. المهام الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة تنفيذها. تحديد مسارات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية وإعداد مخططاتها ومواصفاتها. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. مهارات في تشخيص الأعطال ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق عمل شركة المياه الخليجية للمقاولات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

cedab43c9373da04.description: About Ghithaa Ghithaa (غِذاء) is seeking an Events Planner to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah. This is a full-time position for professionals with 2-5 years of experience in event planning and execution. Role Overview The Events Planner is responsible for managing Ghithaa's participation in relevant external events and for conceptualizing and executing original brand events. This role involves identifying strategic opportunities, fostering brand partnerships, developing new event concepts, and overseeing all aspects of event management from initial idea to post-event wrap-up, ensuring alignment with the company's marketing strategy. Key Responsibilities Maintain a current calendar of fitness, wellness, food, lifestyle, corporate, and community events across KSA. Evaluate each event based on audience fit, reach, cost, and potential for sign-ups, then recommend participation or sponsorship and negotiate terms. Initiate and secure co-hosted events with gyms, studios, sports brands, clinics, corporations, and lifestyle brands. Ensure each collaboration delivers measurable value, such as leads, subscriptions, content, or exposure, and maintain active partner relationships. Develop original event concepts for Ghithaa, including pop-ups, tastings, challenges, community runs, and workshops. Present each concept as a concise proposal detailing objectives, target audience, budget, potential partners, and anticipated results. Manage the end-to-end execution of all approved events, covering budget management, venue selection, permit acquisition, vendor coordination, logistics, staffing, and kitchen catering. Coordinate content coverage before, during, and after events, and provide a comprehensive wrap-up report on attendance, sign-ups, expenditure versus budget, and lessons learned. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in event planning and execution. Demonstrated ability to manage events from concept development to completion. Experience in negotiating partnerships and managing vendor relationships. Preferred Skills Familiarity with KSA event permit processes. Basic knowledge of event production elements, including sound, staging, and branding. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah.

ce00cdc3cef8a161.description: About the Role Fakeeh Care Group is seeking an Anesthesia Consultant to join their team in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is responsible for ensuring quality assurance activities comply with the standards set by accreditation agencies within FCMS. Prepare quality guidelines and conduct training workshops for staff and students. Guide the implementation of quality improvement initiatives. Review reports on performance indicators and their improvement strategies. Oversee the implementation of the Quality Strategic Plan, monitor its progress, and provide advice. Advise on performance improvement in accordance with agreed standards. Monitor the implementation of the Quality Management System and report outcomes. Report quality assurance activities at FCMS to relevant bodies. Guide quality improvement projects in collaboration with executive authorities. Perform other assigned duties within the scope of the job. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. Specific educational qualifications were not provided but are expected to align with the responsibilities of an Anesthesia Consultant. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within the Fakeeh Care Group. The role involves working within FCMS to uphold and enhance quality standards. Application Process Salary details for this position will be disclosed during the application process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply directly.

ce9d972c27311792.description: About the Operations Executive Role Amazon Saudi Arabia is establishing a new organization focused on designing and launching new business models across AMET. We are seeking an experienced Operations Executive to join the Amazon ANOW operations team in Al Qassim. This full-time role is integral to redefining fast delivery services and managing 3P Store Operations. Role Overview The Operations Executive will play a key role in building and running new services for customers, specifically focusing on UTR/OTR operations in KSA. This position involves ensuring compliance with Amazon policies, including fair and consistent attendance tracking. The successful candidate will be responsible for motivating, coaching, reporting on, and providing feedback regarding associate performance to meet or exceed Amazon's expectations in productivity, quality, and safety. Key Responsibilities Manage daily end-to-end UTR/OTR operations for either one large site or a combination of smaller sites, overseeing store operations. Meet customer-facing metrics while maintaining operational and quality targets, and upholding team safety and morale. Drive performance management for team members. Prepare and implement training and development plans for pickers. Collaborate with merchant stakeholders to continuously improve operational processes and achieve sustained performance improvement. Conduct daily 4M / 5S and Safety GEMBA audits for stores. Act as a stand-in for the Area Manager when required. Required Qualifications Candidates for this role should possess a strong record of achieving results in operations. The position requires an individual capable of managing complex operational processes and leading a team effectively. Specific experience requirements were not provided, but a background in operations management is essential. Work Environment and Company Mission This role is part of a newly formed organization within Amazon ANOW operations, focused on innovation and expansion across AMET. The overall mission of Amazon is to be the primary destination for customers to find, discover, and purchase anything online. The Operations Executive will contribute directly to enabling customers to discover new worlds and implementing innovation within this framework.

ce163c4afe8e2cf2.description: About the Role DP World is seeking an Assistant Manager Information Security & Network to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position focused on managing critical information security and networking functions to uphold the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of systems. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to oversee and manage all aspects of information security and network operations. The Assistant Manager will be responsible for ensuring robust security measures are in place and that network infrastructure operates reliably and securely. Key Accountabilities Develop and enforce comprehensive network and security policies. Monitor and manage security systems including firewalls, Intrusion Detection/Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS), and Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems. Ensure continuous compliance with ISO 27001 standards, National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) regulations, and internal DP World policies. Coordinate and lead responses to security incidents, ensuring timely resolution and mitigation. Manage vendor contracts and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) related to network and security services. Experience Requirements Candidates for this position should possess 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in information security and network management. This experience should include a strong background in implementing and maintaining security protocols and network infrastructure. Location and Work Type This full-time role is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The position requires a dedicated presence to manage on-site security and network operations effectively. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

ceb87af395fcca02.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الحبيب للتجارة والتعهدات التجارية عن فني صيانة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في القنفذة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان الأداء الفعال للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية من خلال تشخيص الأعطال وتنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع المخططات الميكانيكية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية لتحديد إجراءات تشخيص الأعطال. تشخيص أعطال المنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية، وتقدير كمية وتكلفة مواد ومستلزمات الصيانة، ومتابعة توفيرها. متابعة إجراءات إصلاح الأعطال وفحص الأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية بعد الإصلاح للتأكد من دقة أدائها وضبطها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية وفقاً للجداول الزمنية المحددة. إعداد وتقديم وتوثيق وحفظ تقارير العمل المتعلقة بأنشطة الصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال صيانة المعدات الميكانيكية. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الميكانيكية. مهارات قوية في تشخيص الأعطال وتحديد أسبابها. القدرة على تقدير التكاليف والمواد اللازمة للصيانة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة القنفذة بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان استمرارية وكفاءة العمليات التشغيلية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة الحبيب للتجارة والتعهدات التجارية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. تفاصيل الراتب ستتم مناقشتها خلال المقابلة.

ce3bcff925c0c22d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ياسر احمد العقبي للاستشارات المهنية عن محلل نظم معلومات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على جمع وتحليل متطلبات العملاء، وتصميم الحلول، وضمان جودة الأنظمة المطورة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال تحليل نظم المعلومات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع متطلبات العميل واحتياجاته من خلال إجراء المقابلات وتنظيم الاستقصاءات. تحليل العمليات التجارية والإجراءات والممارسات المتبعة، وترجمة احتياجات العملاء إلى وظائف ومتطلبات نظامية. صياغة وثائق التصميم ومخططاته الانسيابية، وإعداد نماذج البيانات ومخططات التدفق الوظيفية. إعداد وعرض العناصر المطلوبة من المشروع بشكل واضح ومفصل. إجراء الاختبارات وتحليل تقييم الأداء لضمان تقيد البرامج والتطبيقات بالمعايير المحددة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال تحليل نظم المعلومات. فهم عميق لعمليات جمع المتطلبات وتحليلها. القدرة على إعداد وثائق التصميم ومخططات التدفق الوظيفية ونماذج البيانات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التحليل وحل المشكلات. القدرة على التواصل الفعال مع العملاء والفرق الفنية. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إعداد الوثائق والاختبارات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل محلل نظم المعلومات ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تقديم حلول استشارية مهنية عالية الجودة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. نحن نشجع المتقدمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة على التقديم.

ce3baa46dc5b564f.description: About Noon Noon is a prominent consumer commerce platform in the region, established in Saudi Arabia and the UAE in 2017, and expanded to Egypt in 2019. The Noon ecosystem encompasses marketplaces for food delivery, quick-commerce, fintech, and fashion. Noon Minutes, a hyper-local delivery platform, provides a localized assortment of FMCG and grocery products with delivery within 15 minutes, operating across the UAE, KSA, and Egypt. The Role of Category Manager - Electronics Noon is seeking a Category Manager - Electronics to join the Commercial Team at Noon Minutes in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role supports multiple platforms within Noon Group and requires a strong focus on action and a diligent work ethic to achieve growth targets. Candidates should have 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Support the development of the overall category roadmap and vision, taking direct responsibility for achieving revenue and gross margin targets for relevant categories across multiple Noon platforms. Define optimal assortment, plan stock responsibly, and drive pricing decisions for P&L efficiencies while maintaining competitiveness. Source new brand partnerships and execute product launches. Collaborate with vendors to source marketing investments and ensure campaigns are executed to high standards, working closely with the Ads team. Ensure customer experience is prioritized in all category decisions through a curated assortment, thoughtful in-app merchandising, and best-in-class product content. Implement consumer journeys across channels by combining a deep understanding of the category and customer base. Develop relationships with distributors and brands to identify gaps, increase consumer engagement through campaigns, and drive adoption of Noon’s in-app and out-of-app tools. Work on cross-functional obligations, including in-stock, operations, customer service, growth, and legal teams, to improve the platform and experience using data insights. Stay informed on regional competitors and global business trends, reviewing critical information and innovating product offerings. Contribute to talent development by sharing knowledge and training junior team members. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will demonstrate high standards and an understanding of the importance of diligent work. This role requires individuals who are resourceful, operate with a strong bias for action, and possess the courage to be original in their approach. Adaptability, a willingness to pivot, and continuous learning are essential for success within Noon's environment.

cecf8a246bcd8452.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مكتب فايد للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس طرق للانضمام إلى فريقه في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إجراء الدراسات الفنية لمشاريع إنشاء الطرق، وتحديد المسارات المثلى، وإعداد التصاميم الهندسية، ومتابعة التنفيذ لضمان مطابقة المواصفات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في المجال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة الصور الجوية والمخططات الطبوغرافية والتقارير المائية والجيولوجية والبيئية المتعلقة بمشاريع الطرق. تحليل بدائل المسارات واختيار المسار الأنسب لكل مشروع. إعداد التصاميم الأولية وتحديد مواقع الجسور والعبارات واتجاهاتها وسعاتها. تحديد مواقع الجدران الاستنادية على جوانب الطريق. دراسة المواد المتوفرة وتحديد خصائصها واختيار الأنسب منها لطبقات الرصف. تصميم طبقات الرصف وتحديد أنواعها وسماكتها ومكوناتها. متابعة تنفيذ مشاريع الطرق لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال هندسة الطرق. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال هندسة الطرق. القدرة على إجراء الدراسات الفنية الشاملة لمشاريع الطرق. مهارات قوية في إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية. القدرة على متابعة التنفيذ وضمان مطابقة المواصفات. المهارات المطلوبة تحليل البيانات الفنية والجغرافية. تصميم طبقات الرصف وتحديد مكوناتها. إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. متابعة المشاريع وإدارة الجودة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مكتب فايد للاستشارات الهندسية بالمدينة المنورة، وتتطلب التزاماً بمتابعة المشاريع الهندسية وفقاً للمعايير المعتمدة. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة التفاصيل.

cee2721b05ccdafa.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة نبع الطاقة للمقاولات عن مهندس زراعي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة خصائص الأراضي والتربة الزراعية، وتصميم شبكات الري والصرف، وتحديد الآلات الزراعية المناسبة، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة الخصائص الفيزيائية والكيميائية للتربة الزراعية ومكوناتها. متابعة فحص عينات النبات والتربة ومياه الري وتحليل نتائجها. دراسة واختبار أنواع الأسمدة المناسبة وتقييم مدى استجابة المزروعات لها. دراسة أنظمة الري واختيار الأنسب منها (كالري السطحي، بالرشاشات، المحوري، أو الموضعي). تصميم مخططات وشبكات الري والصرف الزراعي ومتابعة إجراءات التركيب. تقييم كفاءة أنظمة الري وتطويرها. تحديد الآلات الزراعية المناسبة (مثل آلات الحراثة، الزراعة، الرش، الحصاد، جرش وخلط الحبوب). إعداد برامج تشغيل وصيانة الآلات الزراعية والتأكد من جاهزيتها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الزراعي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الزراعية. معرفة قوية بخصائص التربة الزراعية وأنظمة الري المختلفة. القدرة على تصميم مخططات شبكات الري والصرف الزراعي. فهم جيد للآلات الزراعية وكيفية تشغيلها وصيانتها. متطلبات العمل الالتزام بالعمل بدوام كامل. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية المتخصصة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لحل المشكلات المتعلقة بالتربة والزراعة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة جدة بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور العمل ضمن فريق متخصص في مجال المقاولات الزراعية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

ce0e59fd293a408f.description: About the Role Nestlé Saudi Arabia LLC is seeking a Senior Brand Manager for Coffee to lead the Coffee business across Saudi Arabia, Oman, and Bahrain. والمنظومة في تبني الأفكار الجديدة وتحويلها إلى حلول عملية قابلة للتطبيق. سيعمل المرشح مع خبراء الابتكار لتفعيل أدوات وتقنيات الابتكار والتقنيات الناشئة، وتصميم وتوثيق المبادرات الابتكارية التي تعزز Cases) المناسبة لمشاريع القطاع الحكومي. إدارة وتشغيل منصات إدارة الأفكار الرقمية، ومتابعة زمن المعالجة والامتثال لاتفاقيات مستوى الخدمة (SLA). إعداد التقارير التشغيلية الدورية وبناء وتحديث لوحات مؤشرات الابتكار. دعم فرق العمل وتيسير الابتكار التحضير لورش عمل التفكير التصميمي (Design Thinking)، والمشاركة الفعالة في تيسيرها وتوثيق مخرجاتها. دعم الفرق في بناء النماذج الأولية السريعة للحلول ce7b78c1e254f1a3.description: About the Role Maaden is seeking a Chief Specialist, Asset Reliability, to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role is critical for maximizing asset performance, availability, and lifecycle value across the organization. The Chief Specialist will provide enterprise leadership for asset reliability, integrating operational priorities, maintenance strategies, asset health insights, and technology capabilities across various business units and sites. Role Purpose and Impact The primary purpose of this role is to transition reliability decisions from reactive interventions to proactive, predictive, and risk-based approaches. The Chief Specialist will translate reliability and maintenance challenges into scalable business and technology solutions designed to enhance equipment performance, minimize avoidable disruptions, and optimize the total cost of ownership. As the enterprise domain authority, this position ensures that reliability outcomes, decision logic, and technology priorities are aligned across all assets, focusing initiatives on high-value opportunities that can be effectively scaled throughout Maaden. Key Responsibilities Shape enterprise asset reliability priorities, KPIs, and value outcomes to enhance asset performance and lifecycle value across business units. Establish consistent reliability and maintenance decision principles, directing investment and intervention towards high-value asset risks and opportunities. Provide technical authority on asset reliability, influencing strategies, priorities, and solutions among operational and technology stakeholders. Translate asset performance, maintenance, and cost challenges into clear improvement opportunities with measurable value hypotheses. Enable proactive, predictive, and risk-based maintenance decisions to improve reliability, maintainability, availability, and total cost of ownership. Utilize asset performance insights to identify recurring reliability constraints and focus improvement initiatives on sustainable performance. Shape end-to-end solutions that integrate asset health monitoring, diagnostics, maintenance planning, and operational execution. Establish closed-loop approaches that leverage asset performance and maintenance outcomes for continuous improvement of reliability decisions. Ensure reliability solutions are scalable, interoperable, and aligned with operational requirements and enterprise technology direction. Align Maintenance, Operations, Engineering, and Supply Chain stakeholders on asset criticality, reliability priorities, and performance outcomes. Partner with analytics, AI, monitoring, and digital teams to translate reliability needs into deployable technology solutions. Integrate reliability initiatives and technical designs to minimize fragmentation, strengthen reuse, and accelerate enterprise adoption. Advance enterprise reliability practices by applying proven methods, technology, and data-driven approaches to priority asset challenges. Build reliability capability through technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and the adoption of consistent practices across relevant teams. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in asset reliability or a related field. Demonstrated ability to lead and implement enterprise-wide reliability strategies. Strong technical knowledge in asset health monitoring, diagnostics, and maintenance planning. Experience in integrating technology solutions for reliability improvements. Success Metrics Success in this role will be measured by: Consistent definition and application of asset reliability priorities, KPIs, and value outcomes across business units and assets. Improvement in asset reliability, availability, and maintainability through targeted, data-driven interventions. Increased use of proactive, predictive, and risk-based insights in maintenance decisions. Contribution of reliability improvements to lower avoidable disruption and optimized total cost of ownership. Effective closed-loop decision-making across asset health, maintenance planning, and operational execution. Scalability of reliability solutions and technology investments, aligned with business priorities and delivering measurable operational value. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic environment focused on maximizing asset performance and operational efficiency.

ce634adbc93c049d.description: We are seeking an experienced Plant Tissue Culture Technician responsible for the laboratory-based propagation of rare, endangered, difficult-to-propagate, and high-value plant species using tissue culture and micropropagation techniques . The role will support living plant collections, plant conservation programmes, and specialised in-vitro propagation activities. The successful candidate will establish and maintain sterile laboratory conditions, prepare culture media, initiate and maintain plant cultures, monitor plant development, and support the acclimatisation of tissue-cultured plants. Key Responsibilities Propagate rare, endangered, difficult-to-propagate, and high-value plant species using tissue culture and micropropagation techniques. Initiate, establish, multiply, root, and maintain in-vitro plant cultures according to species-specific protocols. Select and prepare suitable explant material for tissue culture initiation. Perform surface sterilisation and maintain strict aseptic techniques to minimise contamination. Prepare and modify plant tissue culture media, including nutrients, vitamins, plant growth regulators, carbohydrates, and gelling agents. Monitor cultures for growth, development, contamination, physiological abnormalities, and overall performance. Conduct routine subculturing and transfer plant material under sterile conditions. Maintain appropriate temperature, photoperiod, light intensity, and other environmental conditions for tissue cultures. Operate, clean, sterilise, and maintain laboratory equipment including autoclaves, laminar-flow cabinets, growth chambers, balances, pH meters, and microscopes . Monitor equipment performance and coordinate maintenance and calibration requirements. Implement laboratory cleaning, sterilisation, contamination-control, and waste-management procedures. Identify sources of microbial contamination and implement corrective and preventive measures. Support the transfer and acclimatisation of tissue-cultured plants from in-vitro to ex-vitro conditions. Develop, refine, document, and standardise tissue culture protocols for priority plant species. Maintain detailed records covering explant sources, media formulations, culture dates, subcultures, treatments, contamination rates, multiplication rates, rooting success, and plant survival. Maintain laboratory inventories of culture media components, consumables, chemicals, glassware, and sterile materials. Support plant conservation and recovery programmes for endangered, threatened, rare, and difficult-to-propagate species. Assist with research and trials aimed at improving propagation success. Provide practical training and technical guidance to staff, interns, and students. Ensure laboratory activities comply with applicable health, safety, chemical handling, biological material, biosecurity, and laboratory operating requirements. Degree in Biology, Plant Biology, Botany, Biotechnology, Plant Sciences, Horticulture , or a related field. Formal training in plant tissue culture, micropropagation, plant biotechnology , or related laboratory techniques is preferred. Minimum 5+ years of relevant laboratory experience involving plant tissue culture and micropropagation. Demonstrated practical experience in culture initiation, multiplication, subculturing, rooting, and culture maintenance . Experience propagating rare, endangered, difficult-to-propagate, or high-value plant species is highly desirable. Strong practical experience in explant selection, preparation, surface sterilisation, and aseptic handling . Demonstrated experience preparing and modifying plant tissue culture media and working with plant growth regulators . Extensive experience maintaining sterile laboratory conditions and controlling contamination. Hands-on experience operating autoclaves, laminar-flow cabinets, growth chambers, pH meters, balances, microscopes , and related laboratory equipment. Experience identifying and troubleshooting contamination, culture decline, abnormal growth, poor multiplication, and rooting problems. Experience monitoring environmental conditions for in-vitro cultures. Experience with hardening and acclimatisation of tissue-cultured plants to greenhouse or nursery environments. Experience developing, testing, refining, or documenting species-specific micropropagation protocols. Strong laboratory record-keeping, data-management, inventory-management, and technical documentation skills. Experience supporting plant conservation, ex-situ conservation, or endangered species propagation projects is preferred. Ability to collaborate effectively with botanists, horticulturists, researchers, conservation specialists, and academic institutions . Demonstrated ability to train staff, interns, students, or laboratory personnel in tissue culture techniques. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, observational, and problem-solving skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to perform laboratory procedures consistently and precisely. Previous experience in a botanic garden, plant tissue culture laboratory, research institution, university, conservation facility, commercial micropropagation laboratory, or comparable plant-science environment is preferred

ce584a8491e676f2.description: The Safety Specialist will support the Safety Lead in implementing and maintaining occupational health and safety programs across KAUST facilities, operations, maintenance activities, construction works, and projects . The role will focus on field inspections, audits, risk assessments, incident investigations, safety documentation, contractor engagement, training, corrective action tracking, and compliance with ISO 45001, HSE policies, and applicable regulatory requirements . The position requires a strong field-oriented HSE professional who can identify hazards, evaluate risks, provide practical safety guidance, investigate incidents, and work effectively with facility owners, project teams, contractors, and service providers. Key Responsibilities HSE Program Implementation: Support the Safety Lead in implementing and continuously improving risk-based safety programs across facilities, operations, maintenance, construction, and projects. Safety Inspections & Audits: Conduct risk-based site inspections, safety audits, compliance evaluations, and field verifications to ensure HSE requirements are being followed. Risk Assessment: Perform hazard identification and risk assessments and verify that appropriate control measures are implemented and effective. Safety Documentation Review: Review HSE documents including risk assessments, method statements, safety plans, permits-to-work, lifting plans, excavation plans, confined-space controls, electrical work procedures, and MOC documentation. Incident Investigation: Investigate or support investigations of accidents, injuries, incidents, and near misses, identify root causes, and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Corrective Action Tracking: Monitor corrective and preventive actions arising from inspections, audits, investigations, and observations, ensuring timely closure and escalation of overdue actions. HSE Training & Awareness: Develop and deliver safety training, toolbox talks, workshops, permit-to-work training, and awareness programs to improve employee and contractor competency. Stakeholder & Contractor Support: Provide practical HSE guidance to facility owners, project teams, contractors, service providers, and other stakeholders to support safe execution of activities. HSE Reporting & Data Analysis: Collect and analyze HSE data, KPIs, inspection findings, audit results, incident trends, and corrective action status, providing reports and recommendations to management. Safety Culture & Compliance: Promote a strong safety culture, intervene in unsafe activities, communicate lessons learned, maintain accurate HSE records, and support compliance with ISO 45001, regulations, policies, procedures, and industry best practices. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Science, or a related safety discipline is required. Professional Certification: ISO 45001 Lead Auditor certification is required. Incident Investigation: Certification or formal training in Incident Root Cause Analysis is required. HSE Experience: Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in occupational safety, facilities safety, construction safety, contractor management, projects, auditing, compliance, or related HSE functions. Risk Management: Strong experience in hazard identification, risk assessment, risk control, and implementation of risk-based safety programs. High-Risk Activities: Practical knowledge of safety controls for work at height, lifting operations, excavation, confined spaces, hot work, electrical work, and permit-to-work systems. ISO & Audit Knowledge: Working knowledge of ISO 45001, safety management systems, auditing, inspections, incident investigation, and corrective action management. Knowledge of ISO 19011 and ISO 31000 is an advantage. Safety Certifications: Additional recognized HSE qualifications such as CSP, CHST, NEBOSH Certificate/Diploma, IOSH, or equivalent are preferred. Train-the-Trainer certification is also an advantage. Communication & Reporting: Excellent English communication skills with the ability to prepare professional HSE reports, inspection records, investigation reports, presentations, and safety documentation.

ce97fb798afe50ec.description: Rgheeb is in search of a creative and analytical Trade Marketing Manager to join our growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing trade marketing strategies that enhance brand visibility and drive sales across various retail channels. You will collaborate closely with the sales, marketing, and product development teams to ensure that our products are effectively positioned in the market and resonate with our target audience. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in trade marketing, strong analytical skills, and a passion for innovative marketing solutions. If you are ready to make a significant impact on our brand’s success, we would love to hear from you! Responsibilities Develop annual and quarterly promotional plans in alignment with Sales objectives. Design and execute trade promotions (discounts, bundles, seasonal campaigns). Enhance in-store visibility through POS materials and merchandising initiatives. Analyze promotional performance and measure return on investment (ROI). Support the Sales team with tools, programs, and initiatives to achieve targets. Coordinate with Supply Chain to ensure product availability during campaigns. Monitor competitor activities and market trends. Prepare regular performance reports on trade marketing activities and sales impact. Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field. 8 to 10 years of experience in Trade Marketing in the FMCG industry. Strong understanding of Traditional Trade and/or Modern Trade channels. Experience in promotional planning and performance analysis. Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel.

ce8c1ebf6af62058.description: We are recruiting experienced Finance Professionals for a range of client opportunities across Saudi Arabia . This consolidated role is intended to attract high-caliber finance talent across multiple disciplines, including Financial Accounting, Management Accounting, FP&A, Commercial Finance, and Financial Control . This opportunity is ideal for professionals looking to step into senior-level responsibility and progress toward finance leadership or head-of-finance roles , particularly within fast-growing organizations. Key Responsibilities Responsibilities will vary depending on role focus and organization, and may include: Preparing and reviewing monthly management accounts and financial reports Managing budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes Conducting financial analysis, variance analysis, and performance reporting Overseeing general ledger activities, reconciliations, and month-end close Supporting strategic and commercial decision-making with financial insights Ensuring compliance with IFRS and internal financial control frameworks Coordinating with auditors, tax advisors, and external stakeholders Improving financial processes, reporting accuracy, and controls Mentoring or managing junior finance and accounting staff Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field CPA, ACCA, CA, CIMA, SOCPA, or equivalent professional qualification preferred 5–10+ years of progressive experience in finance or accounting roles Strong working knowledge of IFRS Experience with budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting Advanced Excel skills; ERP experience (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Dynamics, etc.) Strong communication skills and ability to work with senior stakeholders Leadership potential and readiness for increased responsibility Private Health Insurance Pension Plan Paid Time Off Training & Development

ce06f66aa1f4d8f4.description: As an Infrastructure Architect, you will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and maintaining robust technology infrastructure solutions that meet the evolving needs of our organization and clients. You will leverage your expertise in technology and infrastructure architecture, along with your knowledge of information security best practices, to develop scalable and secure infrastructure designs aligned with industry standards and frameworks. What about the role responsibilities? • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into comprehensive infrastructure architecture solutions. • Lead the development and documentation of infrastructure architectures, ensuring alignment with industry standards such as NORA (Networked Operations and Research Area) and TOGAF (The Open Group Architecture Framework). • Drive the adoption of best practices in technology and infrastructure architecture, emphasizing scalability, reliability, and security. • Conduct regular assessments of existing infrastructure to identify areas for improvement and optimization. • Provide technical guidance and expertise to project teams, ensuring adherence to architectural principles and standards. • Stay abreast of emerging technologies, trends, and threats in the field of infrastructure architecture and information security. What should you have to fit in this role? • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. • 4-8 years of experience in technology and infrastructure architecture, with a focus on designing and implementing complex infrastructure solutions. • Proven track record of leading the development of infrastructure architectures in alignment with NORA and TOGAF frameworks. • TOGAF certification preferred. • Strong understanding of information security principles and best practices. • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. To succeed in this role, it's nice to have: • Experience working in multicultural environments or with clients from diverse cultural backgrounds, enhancing your ability to effectively communicate and collaborate with stakeholders across different regions and cultures. • Familiarity with cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, enabling you to integrate cloud-based solutions into infrastructure architectures and leverage the benefits of cloud technology for scalability and flexibility. • Certification or training in relevant areas such as ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library), CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), or CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate), providing additional depth and expertise in key areas of infrastructure architecture and information security.
